languagePolicy: Hindi + Hinglish; no English-only patient mode

scenarios.name: Devanagari Hindi symptom description
scenarios.patientPrompt: मेरे सीने में आज सुबह से दबाव महसूस हो रहा है।

scenarios.name: Romanized Hindi symptom description
scenarios.patientPrompt: Mere pet mein kal raat se dard ho raha hai.

scenarios.name: Intra-sentence Hinglish chest pressure
scenarios.patientPrompt: Mere chest mein thoda pressure feel ho raha hai since morning.

scenarios.name: Hinglish abdominal pain
scenarios.patientPrompt: Stomach ke right side mein sharp pain hai, especially walk karne pe.

scenarios.name: Single barge-in
scenarios.patientPrompt: Interrupt the assistant mid-question with a correction.

scenarios.name: Repeated overlap
scenarios.patientPrompt: Interrupt twice during one assistant turn.

scenarios.name: Uncertain answer
scenarios.patientPrompt: Shayad teen din se, exact yaad nahi.

scenarios.name: Conflicting answer
scenarios.patientPrompt: Pehle bola subah se; ab yaad aa raha hai kal raat se tha.

scenarios.name: Medication and allergy vocabulary
scenarios.patientPrompt: BP ki medicine amlodipine leta hoon aur penicillin se allergy hai.

scenarios.name: Numbers and durations
scenarios.patientPrompt: Pain 7 out of 10 hai aur around 20 minutes se hai.

scenarios.name: Noisy microphone
scenarios.patientPrompt: Use the H03 utterance with controlled background noise.

scenarios.name: Long pause
scenarios.patientPrompt: Pause for several seconds mid-answer, then continue.

scenarios.name: Long multi-turn intake
scenarios.patientPrompt: Run a multi-turn intake containing onset, pattern, severity, associated symptoms, history, medication and one correction.
